items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Corvello hired first -- he hired -- had about two or three different guys... another kid I recommended... and then after that, Corvello got hold of... and that's when he got his best band.

ctx.x: Right. And so you had to take Corvello as second --
And then, after I stayed there about five, six months (unintelligible). And then I would bring Corvello there to play the -- when I finish with my show, I said, Corvello, keep on playing Cuban music.
